In the era of today's large language models, questions about computational methods for aligning content across languages have a new urgency. One area of work focuses on *syntactic* alignment. In the DH world, the standard-setting project for syntactic annotation is the [Universal Dependencies](https://universaldependencies.org) framework, with the goal of  "consistent annotation of grammar (parts of speech, morphological features, and syntactic dependencies) across different human languages."


advocates for some variation of Chomsky's Universal Grammar are having a moment.
